Chapter 7055: Still Alive

Chapter 7055: Still Alive

They were also surprised to see Zhao Dachui being able to submerge in the ocean. In theory, the tribulations should be punishing him since he was one of the masterminds behind the ambush.

“Since when can immortals take a vacation like this?” A golden immortal said.

Tribulations and immortals were sworn enemies, or rather, hunters and prey. Immortals always feared tribulations regardless of their cultivation. This didn’t apply to Zhao Dachui.

“Not just me, my brothers and sisters as well.” Zhao Dachui laughed and waved, seemingly calling others.

“Splash!” Upon his summon, countless heads peeked out of the ocean to the spectators’ astonishment.

Zhao Dachui floating like a fish was shocking enough, yet there were thousands more.

“Eight-winged Grand Immortal!” Someone recognized the nearest face.

“Fellow Daoist Helan...” Another shouted.

“Master!” An overlord recognized his master.

“Heaven Sparrow, Horned Immortal, Measure Immortal...” An immortal who has traveled the world recognized many.

These beings under the ocean were overlords and immortals who participated in Heaven Pit. Among them were even primordial immortals.

“Weren’t they killed?” Someone murmured.

However, they appeared lively and not corpses. Moreover, none could see signs of injuries.

“It’s not them.” An immortal said after receiving no response.

These were friends and seniors of those present in Dusk Realm. Alas, they didn’t bother to answer as if they'd heard nothing.

“Not the real bodies?” A golden immortal found this unbelievable because these beings had the proper aura.

“A type of rebirth?” An overlord asked.

“The most heaven-defying being might be able to revive one, but not this many people.” An immortal disagreed.

“Hahaha, now you will know our ace card.” Ash-serpent and Immortal Bronze laughed after seeing Li Qiye being surrounded by countless cultivators.

“What do they have to do with these dead cultivators?” An immortal became puzzled.

“It must have something to do with the fortress race, they were close to Heavenfall and other celestial immortals.” Another said.

“This is what you were counting on?” Li Qiye responded.

This naturally startled the two. The dead group in Heaven Pit could be considered the strongest force in Heavenrealm, enough to kill a celestial immortal.

Moreover, they had one on their side. How could Li Qiye dismiss their fighting potential?
